verdict.rationale: Svelte's core value proposition is compiler-driven fine-grained reactivity: $state for reactive variables, $derived for computed values that update only when dependencies change, and $effect for side effects tied to specific state, all compiled to surgical DOM updates rather than a virtual DOM diff. Docs and GitHub description explicitly confirm this model, and community reports corroborate the resulting app 'snappiness' and readable generated code. Missing for 10: independent benchmark/hands-on proof isolating that only dependent UI re-renders (vs whole-tree re-render), beyond vendor docs and general anecdotal praise.
